messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service: redis-prod-main · severity: critical · incident: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8764|PD-8764> · trigger: 'ERR maxclients' seen in logs · timestamp=1739123456

pagerduty: Incident PD-8764 created and routed to on-call rotation 'eng-oncall'. Escalation policy will run if not acked in 2m.

maya: Acked. I'm the oncall (maya). Looking now :eyes:

sam: I'm seeing repeated "maxclients" in redis logs across all primaries. Graphs show client connections spiking ~15:22 UTC.

sam: log snippet:
```
[2025-06-01T15:24:03Z] WARN Rejecting client: maxclients reached (11000)
[2025-06-01T15:24:07Z] WARN Rejecting client: maxclients reached (11000)
```

ingrid: Which services are impacted? I see a bump in 5xx from api-prod/cart and session-store. Looks like cache writes failing and causing fallthrough to DB.

alex: Potential quick mitigations: 1) kill idle/normal clients on the Redis primaries to free slots 2) bump `maxclients` config and rolling restart if needed 3) throttle upstream bursters (tokenizer service) 4) fail open to read-replicas for non-critical calls.

maya: Running `redis-cli -h redis-prod-1 INFO clients` now. Output: `connected_clients: 10984` — near limit.

sam: Tried `CLIENT LIST` earlier, many connections are from `tokenizer-worker` pool, short-lived but massive parallelism. Suspect a recent rollout increased concurrency.

alex: Runbook link: <https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/redis-maxclients|redis-maxclients>. Quick command to kill idle clients:
```bash
redis-cli -h redis-prod-1 --no-auth-warning CLIENT KILL TYPE idle SKIPME no
```
Note: SKIPME=no means we might kill healthy ones too; proceed cautiously.

maya: I'm going to `CLIENT KILL TYPE idle` on the primaries, one at a time, and monitor error rates. Will post counts.

sam: Alert: auto-restart playbook attempted by deploy-bot earlier and failed due to config lock: "cannot write conf, read-only mount" — probably not safe to restart cluster now.

maya: KILL run on redis-prod-1 -> killed ~420 idle clients. Connected now `connected_clients: 10560`. Error rate on api-prod/cart dropped from 6.2% to 2.0% over 60s.

ingrid: Nice. Can we also throttle tokenizer-worker? There's a per-process env var `TOK_POOL_SIZE`. We can push a hotfix to reduce concurrency temporarily.

alex: If needed, increase `maxclients` on the config and do a rolling restart of primaries. Steps in runbook. However rolling restarts risk brief blips — prefer client kill + upstream throttles first.

maya: Updating PD status: acknowledged / investigating. Customer impact: some API paths returning 502/503, estimated ~3% of requests impacted across NA region. Affected services: session-store, cart, notifications (non-critical).

sam: I can patch a rate limit rule at the gateway to cap tokenization requests per IP to reduce connection burst. Pushing now.

sam: Gateway patch deployed (rate-limit 50r/s per instance) — observing further drop in clients. connected_clients: 9800. Error rate down to 0.7%.

maya: Paging update: PD-8764 status -> mitigation in progress. No customer-facing incident page yet, CS notified via #customer-success.

ingrid: I'm taking over triage for next 30m — maya, handing off now (15:35 UTC). Please add any notes to PD.

maya: Handoff ack. Summary: cause = sudden surge from tokenizer-worker after recent pr; mitigation = killed idle clients + gateway rate-limit; next actions = postmortem + change to tokenizer concurrency defaults + consider increasing maxclients with config update.

pagerduty: Incident PD-8764 updated: owner=ingrid · status=investigating -> mitigation_in_progress. Next escalation suppressed.

ingrid: I'll coordinate the follow-ups: 1) rollback/patch tokenizer PR that increased pool size 2) deploy permanent rate-limiter in front of tokenizer 3) create Infra task to evaluate appropriate `maxclients` and connection pooling best-practices.

alex: Also add alerting: spike in `connected_clients` should fire a warning earlier (e.g., 75% of configured max). I can add that rule after handoff.

maya: Thanks team. I'll update PD with timeline and brief notes. We'll run RCA template after incident. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Auto-note: incident log link: <https://incidents.redwood.com/PD-8764/logs|PD-8764 logs>. Remind to file postmortem within 72h.

ingrid: Closing this thread for operational chatter — continuing in PD and follow-up doc. If something regresses ping me.

maya: thx, nice quick ops.
